description: Knowledge matrix for The Things I Let Him See, Book 1. Tracks what each character knows, when they know it, and what they must not know before certain milestones. Milestones derived from total_chapters=18: 5 slots at approximately 2%, 20%, 50%, 72%, 100% → [1, 4, 9, 13, 18].

Calder Reed.ch1: Knows: Grant hired him for 21-day surveillance; he retains unedited originals and field notebook; Lena is the target; Grant claims Lena is unstable.
Calder Reed.ch4: Knows: Lena's visible routines (courtyard, mailbox, walks); she sometimes looks toward his window; Grant's reports match his own observations so far; no proof of manipulation yet.
Calder Reed.ch9: Knows: Grant entered Lena's apartment with master credential (Ch7 evidence); Lena confronted him, knows his surname, inferred Grant hired her; she tests whether he keeps originals; Calder learns she is aware of surveillance.
Calder Reed.ch13: Knows: Lena's doorframe seals and paper planner exist (shown Ch11); certified envelope was mailed (Ch8); Grant used 'Friday key return' phrase (Ch12); Mae printed audit (Ch13); Lena controls what he sees but not the full extent.
Calder Reed.ch18: Knows: Lena's complete strategy (Ch14 reveal); evidence transferred to Cross (Ch15); Grant's false chain exposed (Ch17); Lena asks him to return without recording equipment (Ch18); romance chosen after all dependencies end.

must_not_know_before.ch4: That Lena is aware of surveillance.
must_not_know_before.ch9: The full extent of Lena's diagnostic tests or the honeytoken purpose.
must_not_know_before.ch13: That Lena knew the envelope theft was recorded (she didn't).
must_not_know_before.ch18: Whether Lena will resume the relationship after the settlement.

Calder Reed.hidden_truth: Calder believes observation gives him ownership of Lena's reality until Ch14. He does not know Lena controlled the decisive visible sequence until she reveals it.

Lena Hart.ch1: Knows: Grant is manipulating her environment (displaced objects, missing mail, deleted portal entries); she has no independent witness or reliable digital record; she begins building physical evidence (seals, planner, red receipts).
Lena Hart.ch4: Knows: Someone is watching her from across the courtyard (reflected status light); Grant's messages coincide with her observations; she infers Grant hired an observer but does not know identity or loyalty; she begins diagnostic tests.
Lena Hart.ch9: Knows: Calder's surname is Reed (from lobby package); he keeps unedited originals (confirmed in confrontation); she sets terms for alliance; she knows Grant entered her apartment (seal evidence) but not that Calder recorded it.
Lena Hart.ch13: Knows: Certified envelope was intercepted (Grant used the phrase); Calder recorded the envelope removal (unknown when she mailed it); Mae printed the audit; she withholds full strategy from Calder until Ch14.
Lena Hart.ch18: Knows: Grant's manipulation fully exposed; she retains apartment; Calder transferred evidence and obeys her limits; she chooses to invite him back without recording equipment.

must_not_know_before.ch4: Calder's full identity or that he keeps originals.
must_not_know_before.ch9: That Calder recorded Grant's entry (she infers but doesn't confirm until later).
must_not_know_before.ch13: The exact contents of Mae's audit (she learns in Ch13).
must_not_know_before.ch18: Whether Calder will accept her terms after the settlement.

Lena Hart.hidden_truth: Lena has been designing what Calder sees since Ch3, but does not know every result in advance. She withholds the full strategy until Ch14.

Grant Hart.ch1: Knows: Calder accepted the contract; can observe Lena's courtyard-facing rooms; Lena is noticing displaced objects and missing mail; Mae expressed uncertainty; reports support instability; deadline nears.
Grant Hart.ch4: Knows: Calder submits usable reports; Lena remains; Mae still uncertain; his manipulation continues via duplicate key, master credential, admin access, portal edits, timed messages.
Grant Hart.ch9: Knows: Calder still submits reports; Lena remains; may be packing; Mae supports her; Calder refuses to enter apartment; envelope holds false checklist and 'Friday key return' phrase (he stole it).
Grant Hart.ch13: Knows: Mae accessed the terminal; Calder's reports are thinner; Lena remains; Calder will attend the session; Grant holds the envelope and false checklist; edited dashboard no longer shows his entries.
Grant Hart.ch18: Knows: His false chain of custody was contradicted by footage, audit, notebook, planner, contract; he lost admin access; settlement halted; he does not confess to stealing the envelope.

must_not_know_before.ch9: That Calder recorded the Ch7 entry or the envelope removal.
must_not_know_before.ch13: That Mae printed the audit or where it is hidden.
must_not_know_before.ch18: The full extent of Lena's planning or Calder's alliance with her.

Grant Hart.hidden_truth: Grant believes Calder is a controllable paid observer. He does not know Calder stopped serving his objective in Ch7. He proceeds believing all digital records remain his and Calder's financial dependence outweighs any attachment.

Mae Hart.ch1: Knows: Lena may be stressed; Grant's systems appear accurate; she trusts Grant's board role and the edited dashboard.
Mae Hart.ch4: Knows: Lena reports disturbances; Grant expresses concern; she has no reason to doubt Grant's version.
Mae Hart.ch9: Knows: Lena remains in the apartment; Grant is concerned; Calder is the operative; she supports Lena but still trusts Grant's systems.
Mae Hart.ch13: Knows: She printed the local credential audit from the board terminal; she hides it in a cookbook; she now has independent physical evidence that Grant's access was used during deleted intervals.
Mae Hart.ch18: Knows: The audit was used to expose Grant; she gives Lena a sealed archived complaint from another condominium (Book 2 hook).

must_not_know_before.ch4: That Grant is actively manipulating Lena's environment.
must_not_know_before.ch9: The full extent of Grant's access or the deleted intervals.
must_not_know_before.ch13: That the audit will be decisive evidence (she prints it but doesn't know its full significance yet).
must_not_know_before.ch18: The contents of the archived complaint (she gives it sealed).

Mae Hart.hidden_truth: Mae changes her belief after printing the audit in Ch13. She initially trusts Grant's systems and only discovers the manipulation through independent physical evidence.

Detective Cross.ch1: Knows: Nothing about the case. Not yet involved.
Detective Cross.ch13: Knows: Nothing about the case. Calder has not yet contacted her.
Detective Cross.ch18: Knows: Received evidence index and encrypted duplicate (Ch15); attended settlement (Ch17); confirms material establishes offenses but requires independent verification; takes custody of originals.

must_not_know_before.ch18: The full chain of custody before verification.

Detective Cross.hidden_truth: Cross refuses to treat one accusation as sufficient. She requires independent verification before any official action.
